card.statement:
In recent years, the finite $W$-algebras associated to a semisimple Lie algebra $\ga$ and a nilpotent element of $\ga$ have been studied intensively from different viewpoints. In this lecture series, we shall present some basic constructions, connections, and applications of finite $W$-algebras. The topics include:

- various equivalent definitions of $W$-algebras

- independence of $W$-algebras on choices of Lagrangian subspaces

- $W$-algebras as quantization of Slodowy slices

- classification of good $\Z$-gradings in type $A$

- independence of $W$-algebras on choices of good gradings

- category equivalence between $W$-algebra modules and Whittaker $\ga$-modules

- higher level Schur duality between $W$-algebras and Hecke algebras

- $W$-(super)algebras in prime characteristic
card.label: Abstract
